_about: Limits for the real style's water, for tools/look.mjs --check against tools/look/water.json (npm run check:water): the water reflects what stands over it, is paler at the shore and has foam there, a river's pattern moves down it, and what it costs. water.json is what the page gave of the same four places with the water as the sea has it in the other styles. A rule: { shot, metric, min, max }, or against it: { ..., of: 'baseline', maxRatio, maxAdd, minAdd }.
